text:
julian: Two-wave launch tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Change window 01:30-03:30 UTC. Plan: wave A (EU-only canary), 02:00-02:15; wave B (global ramp) 02:30. Need final pin/unpin and rollback triggers.

maria: Ack. Release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-22 (configs, DB migration notes).

noah: Can we pin v4.2.0 to eu-canary before 01:50 so we have 10m warmup?

julian: Yes. @deploy-bot will handle pin. After canary green for 10m we do global pin, else rollback to v4.1.9.

deploy-bot: scheduled action: /pin version=v4.2.0 target=eu-canary at=01:50 UTC (initiated by julian) :gear:

sarah: Quick checklist: smoke endpoint tests ✅, embeddings smoke ✅, latency check under 120ms for p50, error rate <0.5%. If any fail -> immediate unpin + rollback.

ops-oncall: Oncall: me (ops-oncall) + maria. I’ll watch the metrics dashboard and PagerDuty. If we hit >=2% errors in 5m window, we abort wave B.

maria: Production DB change is a read-only index add scheduled at 02:10 during canary. If that fails we stop before global. Note: roll-forward path requires toggling feature-flag ff/enable-v4-2.

noah: For rollback we’ll use pin v4.1.9 + clear KV cache for inference nodes. Command: 
```
/deploy pin version=v4.1.9 target=all && /infra kvcache flush --scope=inference
```

julian: Agree. Add runbook step: after rollback, set traffic to 0 for 5m then re-evaluate.

deploy-bot: canary pin applied to eu-canary at 01:50 UTC — started rollout (julian).

sarah: Reminder: keep deploy window quiet. No schema migrations besides the index. No non-critical merges til 04:00 UTC.

maria: I pasted the final release notes to #release-notes channel. Also flagged a known minor regression in interactive prompts — monitor qualitative alerts.

ops-oncall: If canary shows CPU > 85% for 5m, we throttle and then abort wave B. Thresholds listed in the runbook.

julian: Final call: thumbs? If no objections by 01:20 UTC I’ll proceed with the scheduled pins. :thumbsup:

noah: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup: watching logs during canary.

sarah: :thumbsup: I’ll run the smoke set at 02:05.

deploy-bot: global pin scheduled at 02:30 UTC if canary passes health checks. Otherwise will cancel and post status.

julian: Thanks team — handoff channel during window is this thread. Keep replies short and timestamped.
